content.text:
Systran/faster-whisper-large-v3 -> HTTP 200 "gated":false
pyannote/speaker-diarization-3.1 -> HTTP 200 
pyannote/segmentation-3.0 -> HTTP 200 
pyannote/wespeaker-voxceleb-resnet34-LM -> HTTP 200 "gated":false
speechbrain/lang-id-voxlingua107-ecapa -> HTTP 200 "gated":false

observation.command: for m in "Systran/faster-whisper-large-v3" "pyannote/speaker-diarization-3.1" "pyannote/segmentation-3.0" "pyannote/wespeaker-voxceleb-resnet34-LM" "speechbrain/lang-id-voxlingua107-ecapa"; do enc=$(python3 -c "import urllib.parse,sys;print(urllib.parse.quote(sys.argv[1],safe=''))" "$m" 2>/dev/null || echo "$m"); code=$(timeout 30 curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" "https://huggingface.co/api/models/$enc"); gated=$(timeout 30 curl -sS "https://huggingface.co/api/models/$enc" 2>/dev/null | grep -oE '"gated":[a-z]+' | head -1); echo "$m -> HTTP $code $gated"; done
